my_data.title: My data
my_data.subtitle: View, export, or delete the data PLI holds about you — fully transparent.
my_data.load_error: We couldn't load your data right now.
my_data.export_explain: Download a ZIP archive containing all your data: emails (.eml), contacts (.vcf), and settings (.json). Compatible with Thunderbird, Apple Mail, and Outlook.
my_data.rights_body: At any time, you can access, rectify, export, or delete your data. You can also object to certain processing or request restriction.
my_data.delete_explain: Deleting your account will erase all your data after a 30-day grace period. You can cancel any time during that window.

export.requested: Your export is being prepared. Feel free to close this page — we'll email you when it's ready.
export.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please try again in a few hours.
export.error: Couldn't start the export right now.

delete.modal_body: This schedules your account for deletion. You'll have a 30-day grace period to change your mind.
delete.modal_consequence_data: All your emails, contacts, and attachments will be erased.
delete.modal_consequence_cancel: You can cancel within 30 days by signing back in.
delete.modal_consequence_legal: Some data (invoices, logs) is retained to meet legal obligations.
delete.confirm_permanent: I understand this action is permanent after 30 days.
delete.scheduled: Deletion scheduled. We've sent you a confirmation email.
delete.scheduled_body: Your account will be permanently deleted on {{date}}.
delete.cancel_error: Couldn't cancel the deletion right now.
delete.error: Couldn't schedule the deletion. Please check your password.
